title: Elliott Sets Up Gigamon for Speed Dating
主要内容: Elliott Management Corp., an activist investor focused on undervalued technology companies, has continued its strategy by acquiring a 15.3 percent stake in Gigamon Inc. in 2016. This move signaled Elliott's intent to push for a strategic review, potentially leading to a sale. Following the announcement, Gigamon's shares increased by 17 percent. Elliott has previously succeeded in pushing for the sales of Lifelock Inc. and Mentor Graphics Corp., demonstrating its effectiveness in influencing corporate decisions through activist investing.
